messages.subject: Project Tempest — SPA comments (limitations)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Mark-up to follow but to flag the main points on clause 9 now: we're comfortable with the company cap at the subscription proceeds, but on the founder side we'd push the cap down to £1.5m each (you have £2m), and we'd want the de minimis and basket up (to £35k / £180k) to avoid trivial claims. We'd also want the general warranty limit at 24 months rather than 18.

In exchange we can live with the seven-year tail on fundamentals and tax. Workable?

Oliver
